name: Sennacherib
overview: The biblical account of Sennacherib's invasion of Judah reveals a dramatic confrontation between earthly power and divine sovereignty. As the king of Assyria sends his officials to challenge Hezekiah's trust in God, they mock the reliance on God's protection, comparing it to a fragile reed and urging dependence on Egypt instead. Yet, this encounter underscores the futility of trusting in human strength over the Lord, who alone is worthy of confidence and worship. The narrative sets the stage for God's deliverance of Jerusalem despite the overwhelming Assyrian threat, highlighting His supremacy and faithfulness to His people.
